name: ir_find_page
description:
The investor relations web page URL of a supported company, from SAJHA's company database.
Returns {ticker, ir_page_url, success}.
Inputs (* required): ticker* (string, stock symbol such as AAPL or MSFT; case-insensitive).
Only tickers in SAJHA's built-in company list work (ir_list_supported_companies); others fail with 'not supported'. For the documents on that site use ir_get_documents or ir_get_all_resources.
Example: {"ticker": "MSFT"}

ticker.description: Stock ticker symbol (e.g., TSLA, MSFT, JPM)

ir_page_url.description: URL of the investor relations page

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
useCases: Get IR page URL for analysis
Direct access to company IR resources
